ごめんなさい………

en: CHARLOTTE: ...Awesome.

en: She doesn't like to cry in front of others.

en: I love her, but the girl drives me crazy sometimes.

en: I get that it's bad news, but she's totally overreacting.

en: Apparently she's been replaced already, but this isn't generally how this whole Reborn League thing goes down.

en: CHARLOTTE: Huh.

en: What in the world did you just do?

en: Don't tell me Mom was a fan of hidden rooms, too.

en: CHARLOTTE: Cuz mine sure didn't.

en: CHARLOTTE: Not too shabby, huh?

en: The stars just kind of lined up.

en: But when I realised what was happening,
ja: でも　何が　起きているのか　わかったとき

key: And that there was nothing I could do...

key: I was able to accept it.
en: I was able to accept it.

en: It was then that I saw how really pretty the flames were...

en: Little spirits of immolation, dancing back and forth in the night air...

key: Not.
en: Not.

key: I wasn't interested in regret.
en: I wasn't interested in regret.

en: Most kids would have been traumatized by finding out they killed their own parents, right?

en: They'd hide away and cry at the sight of fire after that.

key: That didn't sound fun.
en: That didn't sound fun.

key: So I embraced it instead.
en: So I embraced it instead.

key: Fire is destruction.
en: Fire is destruction.

key: Destruction is beauty.
en: Destruction is beauty.

en: When there's nothing you can do to stop the creeping flame, all that's left is to sit back and watch the show.

key: I'll put on a marvelous show for you too, so give into it already!
en: I'll put on a marvelous show for you too, so give into it already!
ja: あんたにも　最高のショーを　見せてあげる。さあ　早く　身を　ゆだねなさい!

key: The aftermath was unfortunate, but I want to share that experience with others.
en: The aftermath was unfortunate, but I want to share that experience with others.

key: Destruction is beauty!
en: Destruction is beauty!

key: You should just give into it already!
en: You should just give into it already!

en: Over it. So done.

en: CHARLOTTE: So I'm still powerless.

key: Just like back then.
en: Just like back then.

en: Heh, maybe I'm not entirely free of guilt after all.

en: Doesn't matter.

key: Here.

en: CHARLOTTE: That takes you up to level 75.

en: Plus the whole Dive thing.

en: CHARLOTTE: You have a city to go save, don't you?

en: We'll be fine here, don't worry.

en: Maybe I shouldn't have said that...
